# PrysmNexus

> PrysmNexus is an India-focused growth, automation, and software partner connecting brand strategy, content production, paid media, local SEO, AI workflows, and custom digital products under one accountable team.

## Primary Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.prysmnexus.com/): Brand positioning, selected capabilities, working process, case studies, and FAQ.
- [Services](https://www.prysmnexus.com/services/): Complete overview of our 8 core capabilities.
- [Case Studies](https://www.prysmnexus.com/case-studies/): Named, evidence-backed client work across Indian sectors.
- [Insights & Guides](https://www.prysmnexus.com/insights/): Authoritative playbooks and strategic comparisons for growing Indian businesses.
- [About](https://www.prysmnexus.com/about/): Operating philosophy and multidisciplinary team model.
- [Contact](https://www.prysmnexus.com/contact/): Direct consultation and project enquiry form.

## Core Services

- [Brand Strategy and Identity](https://www.prysmnexus.com/services/brand-strategy/): Positioning, audience definition, messaging framework, and visual design systems.
- [Content Production](https://www.prysmnexus.com/services/content-production/): Commercial photography, food styling, cinematic video, reels, and ad creatives.
- [Social Media Management](https://www.prysmnexus.com/services/social-media-management/): Content calendars, daily publishing, community response, and WhatsApp marketing.
- [Performance Marketing](https://www.prysmnexus.com/services/performance-marketing/): High-intent Google Search, Performance Max, and Meta lead acquisition.
- [SEO, Local Search, and Reputation](https://www.prysmnexus.com/services/seo-local-search-reputation/): Technical SEO, Google Business Profile (GBP), Local 3-Pack rank, and review systems.
- [AI Automation Systems](https://www.prysmnexus.com/services/ai-automation-systems/): CRM pipeline automation, WhatsApp Business API, autonomous AI agents, and n8n orchestration.
- [Brand and PR Authority](https://www.prysmnexus.com/services/brand-pr-authority/): Digital PR, media outreach, podcast bookings, and founder LinkedIn thought leadership.
- [Custom Software and SaaS Development](https://www.prysmnexus.com/services/custom-software-saas/): Web applications, multi-tenant SaaS architectures, dashboards, and MVP engineering.
